Name: Kookiefroggie's Recolor
Author: Kookiefroggie
Description:
[size=3]Now with new modular support and more color options![/size]

[size=4][b][u]Main Features[/u][/b][/size]


[list]
[*][size=3][b]Modular! Grass, Dirt, Cliff colors can be picked or disabled per season.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Multiple Grass, Dirt and Cliff color options.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]More Snow and Darker Snow options. Blue and Grey highlight options.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Retextures Sand and Dark Dirt. [/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Cherry Blossoms, Leaves and Snow can be forced over other recolors/mods or disabled.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Recolors Town Square, light and dark tilled soil. The tilled soil in winter stays brown. [/b][/size][/*]
[/list][center]﻿[/center]
[size=4][b][u]Optional Features[/u][/b]:[/size][size=3]

[b]Config options, I recommend using in the in-game Config-Menu from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]﻿:[/b][/size]
﻿ ﻿
[center][left][list]
[*][b]OutdoorTilesheet Fence Replacement[/b][/*]
[*][b]TownTilesheet Fence Replacement[/b][/*]
[*][b]Make Craftable Hardwood Fence Seasonal[/b][/*]
[*][b]Cosmetic Map Patches[/b][/*]
[*][b]Replace fertilizers with cute vanilla weeds [/b][/*]
[/list][/left]
[/center]

[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/b5zRf2ph/Kookiefroggie-s-Recolor-Backwoods-gif.gif[/img] [/center]
[size=3](Light spots on the dirt etc. are from the color compression in gifs. Please look at the screenshots for more accurate colors.)[/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/7NjK6LKh/Backwoods-Winter-More-Snow-Night.png[/img]

[center][size=3]----------------------------------------------------------------[/size]
[/center]
[size=3]
[b][u]Installation:[/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Unzip this mod and place the folder "[CP] Kookiefroggie's  Recolor" into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Run the game once to generate the config.json.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Edit the config.json. Or use[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098] Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]﻿ to be able to edit the config options in an in-game UI.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][b][u]Compatibility:[/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]Compatible with major expansion mods[/b]: Stardew Valley Expanded, East Scarp, Sunberry Village, Ridgeside Village, Sword and Sorcery[b],[/b] Cape Stardew [/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Modular. Can be mixed with other mods/recolors. [/b]You can for example install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour [/url]to get the toned down buildings etc. and also have the changes my recolor provides. The config options "Force Cherry Blossoms, Leaves, Snow" can be used to force Cherry Blossoms, Leaves and Snow from this mod over grass and dirt from other mods.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Currently no trees/bushes get edited, so you can pick something like Simple Foliage (like shown in the screenshots).[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Works on Android.[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][b]Compatibility patches included for:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]﻿ with permission from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657]lemurkat[/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10448]Lumisteria Tilesheets - Outdoor[/url]﻿ with permission from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5575844]Lumisteria[/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10881]Xiddav's Tilesheet[/url]﻿ with permission from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54167332]xiddav[/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15707]MixedBag's Tilesheets[/url]﻿ with permission from[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2852735] JefGrizli[/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28434]crystalinerose Tilesheets[/url]﻿ with permission from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/58438236]crystalinerose[/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13743]Alvadea's Tilesheets[/url]﻿ with permission from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2816980]Alvadea[/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2816980]﻿[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url] with permission from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/61079406]DaisyNiko[/url][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28480]AToMS - Archie's Tilesheets of Miscellaneous Stuff[/url]﻿ with permission from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/29253885]ArchibaldTK[/url][/size][/*]
